name: The Last Year
source:
The Last Year is a visual novel game where you take on the role of a new student who has just transferred to a school far from the big city. It's your final year in school, and how memorable you make this last year is up to you.

[From [URL=https://yuzururin.itch.io/the-last-year]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
《The Last Year》是一款视觉小说游戏，你将扮演一名刚转学到远离大城市的学校的新生。这是你在学校的最后一年，你的最后一年如何令人难忘取决于你。

[来自 [URL=https://yuzururin.itch.io/the-last-year]itch.io[/URL]]
